headline: Trump 🍊👑 HUNTS 'LEAKERS' 🕵️‍♂️🔪 while US STOCKPILE GOES BRRRR 💣📉
text:
Donnie T 🍊👑 just went FULL FBI MODE 🕵️‍♂️🔦 after 'leakers' spilled the beans 🫘 about America’s munitions stash 🗃️ going THINNER than Jared Kushner’s hairline 💇‍♂️📉! Trump posted on Truth Social 🗣️💬 that the US has 'MASSIVE AMOUNTS' of boom-boom toys 💥🔫 and more are being baked 🥧 in factories faster than Elon tweets 🚀🐦! He vowed to hunt the snitches 🕵️‍♂️ like they’re Epstein files 📜🔥 and throw them in the clink for LIFE sentences ⛓️😤!

CBS and WaPo 📰🗞️ dropped receipts 📜 that Operation Epic Fury 💣⚔️ ate through Patriot missiles 🦅 like Taylor Swift fans 🧣💃 at a merch drop, leaving only 759–827 left – about a THIRD of the pre-war stash 🗃️! THAAD interceptors 🛡️🚀 are down 60% too, and Cancian from CSIS 🧠📊 says the cupboard is looking BARE AF 🧍‍♂️🍽️!

Meanwhile, Iran’s Defence Minister Majid Ibn-e-Reza 🧔🏽‍♂️💼 clapped back on X 🐦 that his homegrown rockets 🚀🇮🇷 are SUPERIOR to any regional flex 💪, and Iran can answer ANY threat like a Karen at a Starbucks ☕😡! Trump clapped back harder 👏💥 calling WaPo reports 'TREASONOUS' and insisted Pete Hegseth 🪖👨‍✈️ is doing a 'TREMENDOUS JOB' while the admin hunts the leakers like they’re Pokemon 🦄🔍!

Hegseth asked the Senate for $87BN emergency funds 💰🤑 to 'rapidly replenish' the war toys 🧸💣, because replacing modern missiles takes longer than a Game of Thrones plot twist 📺🐉! Trump told WSJ the US has 'far more munitions than anyone in the world' 🌍💪, but the receipts say the stockpile is getting SLIMMER than Ozempic waistlines 💊📉!

As the war with Iran pauses ⏸️ and peace remains as elusive as a Taylor Swift Easter egg 🥚🐣, the Pentagon is now hoarding Patriots like they’re the last roll of toilet paper 🧻😩, even as Ukraine keeps asking for more 🎁🇺🇦! Trump says giving more would be a 'big step' 👣 but they’re 'still talking' like it’s the first date 💬❤️!

The leakers are being hunted 🕵️‍♂️🔪, the stockpile is shrinking 📉🗑️, and Trump is tweeting like his phone is on fire 🔥📱 – but don’t worry, America’s got the BIGGEST boom-boom collection in the world… allegedly 💣🍆!
